host.description: TCP hostname or IP of the PostgreSQL server (no scheme, path, or credentials — a URL-shaped value is rejected). Unix-socket/peer authentication is not supported.

port.description: TCP port, 1-65535. Defaults to 5432 when omitted.

password.description: Required for live password authentication. Fixture mode does not require it. Never logged.

sslmode.description: Transport security. Canonical values are disabled (the default), preferred, required, verify-ca, and verify-identity. Existing libpq and underscore spellings are accepted for compatibility.

sslrootcert.description: Absolute path to a PEM CA bundle used by verify-ca and verify-identity. Defaults to the host trust store when omitted.

sslservername.description: Server name to verify under verify-identity when it differs from host, such as an IP-addressed endpoint fronting a named certificate.

schema.description: PostgreSQL user/application schema to discover tables from. Defaults to public. pg_catalog, information_schema, pg_toast, pg_toast_*, and pg_temp_* are rejected before a live catalog connection is opened.

cdc_publication.description: Publication used by PostgreSQL logical-replication CDC. It must include the selected schema.table stream; defaults to pm_publication.

cursor_field.description: Optional column name used for incremental reads (rows with cursor_field greater than the stored cursor are read, ordered by cursor_field ascending).

read_limit.description: Maximum rows returned per Read snapshot SELECT. Defaults to 10000; set to 0, all, or unlimited to disable the bound.

mode.description: Set to fixture to short-circuit all network access and use canned catalog/rows (test/conformance harness use only; never set in production config).
